rows.note: Use 訂 as the all-purpose everyday verb for reserving a room, seat, ticket, or other item in advance.

example.english: I book my movie ticket online every time.
example.jyutping: ngo5 ci3 ci3 dou1 soeng5 mong5 deng6 hei3 fei1

rows.note: This is the all-purpose rendering for a physical book or a published work such as a novel or textbook.

example.jyutping: ni1 bun2 syu1 zan1 hai6 hou2 tai2

rows.note: Use this for a major division of a long work, especially a book of the Bible or another classical or formal work.

example.english: The second volume of this history book mainly covers the Qin dynasty.
example.traditional: 呢本歷史書嘅第二卷主要講秦朝。
example.jyutping: ni1 bun2 lik6 si2 syu1 ge3 dai6 ji6 gyun2 zyu2 jiu3 gong2 ceon4 ciu4

rows.note: Use this for a booklet-like collection of small paper items, as in a stamp booklet or stamp album.

example.jyutping: ngo5 maai5 zo2 bun2 jau4 piu3 bou2
